messages:
Noah: Postmortem posted — need to lock owners for customer comms and follow-ups: status page blurb, 72h customer note, and an RCA-sharing policy. Also infra flagged a recurring eviction pattern. Can we assign before EOD?
Tess: I can take the statuspage blurb. Will keep it factual and non-technical. ETA 3h.
Ibrahim: I'll draft the 72h customer note (plain english + CSM blurb). ETA 24h.
Marina: Legal: I'll own the RCA sharing policy + redaction checklist. Default public = brief summary + statuspage. Sanitized RCA on request after review; full RCA under NDA + redaction pass. ETA 72h.
inc-bot: Created ACTION-5120 (comms) and ACTION-5121 (infra pattern review): https://go/reports/ACTION-5120
Noah: Proposed splits: Tess=statuspage (3h), Ibrahim=72h (24h), Marina=RCA policy (72h). Also create infra follow-up for detection/alerting on the eviction pattern.
Tess: Statuspage draft v0:
"Service degradation for a subset of customers in APAC between 07:18-07:46 UTC. Service restored after failover. We are investigating a recurring cache eviction pattern and will publish follow-up notes"
Tess: I'll add contact: support@redwood.ai and a line that affected customers will get a direct summary.
Ibrahim: 72h note outline: tl;dr, who impacted, timeline, mitigation, root cause (high-level), next steps, how to request more info (support@redwood.ai), expected review SLA: 7 business days. Will add CSM one-paragraph.
Marina: For the policy: three levels (public summary, sanitized RCA, full RCA with NDA), redaction checklist (PII, internal IPs, raw logs), approval flow (legal + infra), and an intake SLA. I'll attach a template.
Noah: Infra says there have been 4 similar evictions in the last 7 weeks. Tag incident "cache-eviction-repeat" and open ACTION-5121 for thresholding and automated alerts. Owner: infra-ops (TBD). ETA: 3w for detection tuning, 6w for mitigations.
Tess: Question: do we name the internal root cause on the public status page?
Marina: Keep public language high-level. Provide technical detail in sanitized RCA. Full technical artifacts only with NDA + redaction approval.
Ibrahim: Will include the request flow and SLA in the 72h note and link to the intake form: https://go/rca-request.
inc-bot: ACTION-5120 updated -> owners assigned: Tess, Ibrahim, Marina. ACTION-5121 created -> infra-ops follow-up.
Noah: Scheduling a 20-min review tomorrow 09:15 UTC to approve drafts and close ACTION-5120. Please upload drafts to ACTION-5120 before the sync.
Tess: Posting statuspage draft to ACTION-5120 now.
Ibrahim: 72h draft will be uploaded by 08:45 UTC tomorrow.
Marina: Policy skeleton and redaction checklist will be in ACTION-5120 within 48h for review.
Noah: Final EOD checklist: update tracker with owners + ETAs (done), statuspage draft posted (Tess), 72h draft (Ibrahim), RCA policy WIP (Marina), infra follow-up ACTION-5121 for recurring pattern. If anything slips DM me.
Ibrahim: ack.
Tess: ack.
Marina: ack.
Noah: thanks all — closing thread until review meeting. :white_check_mark:
